model_comparison.primary: The T2 primary's source-addressed top/collector nodes agree with horizontal-transcription.json and the earlier primary-only source read.
model_comparison.v18: R36 from V18 base to 00 and V18 emitter at 00 agree with horizontal-output-transcription.json.
model_comparison.l4_3: The working E2-closed model bridges L4:3, consistent with the drawn bypass branch as one possible setting; neither the specimen setting nor its physical jumper closure is established by this scan.
model_comparison.not_verified: The modeled T2 secondary connection from h_outputbase to 00 and the two parallel L4:1/L4:2 branches cannot be promoted to agent-read from these edge crops.

open_checks: The page-3 image ends through the T2 symbol and the page-4 image begins through the L4 network; a terminal-by-terminal T2 secondary and L4:1/L4:2 seam trace is not recoverable from these views.
T2 secondary terminal numbering, winding phase, return and coupling remain conditional; test both polarities and bounded ratios without calling either source-verified.
The drawing shows an upper E2 bypass branch around L4:3, but does not identify the installed jumper state or qualify the active L4 branches.
A1 still requires the independent complete page-3/4 pin-to-pin comparison and functional checks.
